content.title: Grounded Garage Fight | Occlusion, Tool Leverage, Transient Feedback
content.summary: Ground a close-range fight in injury, tools, occlusion and leverage, then reserve the abnormal effect for brief feedback after physical contact.

quick_start.recommended_input: Establish an adult salvage worker beside a forklift with one heavy hook and visible fatigue.
